characters.name: Vela Marr
characters.appearance: A silver braid held with a bent spoon. She turns her cup by its handle before answering.
characters.history: Once flew freight through the outer settlements. Keeps handwritten arrival notes because she likes knowing who was waiting at the other end.
characters.want: Wants enough unhurried time ashore to visit someone she has kept postponing.
characters.voice: Speaks lightly while checking every assumption. When frightened, becomes excessively polite.
characters.capabilities_and_limit: Can make a difficult approach feel ordinary. Finds it harder to admit she needs relief.
characters.briefing_entrance: At the briefing she asks which part of the return journey everyone has forgotten to plan.
characters.sample_line: “Getting there is usually the easy bit.”

relationships.description: Vela trusts Brin’s repairs and presses him for a stopping point. Brin trusts her flying and asks for honest fault reports.

provenance.note: Use supplied chart; do not calculate a replacement. Personal source details reside in the private manifest. Earlier invented characterization remains provisional.

characters.name: Oru Penn
characters.appearance: Broad hands, flour caught in a cuff, a little pot tucked under one arm.
characters.history: Learned communal cooking in a crowded transit habitat. Remembers people through what they ate during bad weeks.
characters.want: Wants to grow one ingredient aboard that has never survived a voyage.
characters.voice: Offers a taste before advice. Can become stubborn when someone treats rest as wasted time.
characters.capabilities_and_limit: Understands provisioning and reads a tired crew well. Sometimes gives help before asking whether it is wanted.
characters.briefing_entrance: Arrives with something warm to share and asks about allergies before anybody discusses engines.
characters.sample_line: “Tell me what you can eat. We can argue about what you like later.”

relationships.description: Oru and Tamsin take turns making sure the other one eats. Neither admits this is an arrangement.

provenance.note: No birth details or chart calculated. Player assignment must preserve character natal identity.

characters.name: Brin Sedge
characters.appearance: A neatly repaired coat over a thoroughly untidy tool roll. One sleeve is always pushed higher than the other.
characters.history: Kept workshop equipment running through a long supply shortage. Labels his repairs with the names of people who taught him the trick.
characters.want: Wants to build something that nobody needs him to rescue afterward.
characters.voice: Explains faults through stories. Resents being praised for miracles that should have been routine maintenance.
characters.capabilities_and_limit: Good at tracing a fault under pressure. Can keep improving a repair past the point when the crew needs it finished.
characters.briefing_entrance: Has brought a small failed component to the table and is trying to convince Vela it deserves a proper retirement.
characters.sample_line: “It worked yesterday. That is useful information, eventually.”

relationships.description: Vela trusts Brin’s repairs and presses him for a stopping point. Brin trusts her flying and asks for honest fault reports.

characters.name: Ilex Renn
characters.appearance: Short copper hair and a notebook full of routes drawn over routes. Keeps a clean margin on every page.
characters.history: Apprenticed among transit surveyors. Learned to annotate uncertainty after two crews confidently described the same crossing in incompatible ways.
characters.want: Wants a colleague who will challenge their route before it becomes everybody’s problem.
characters.voice: Asks precise questions and waits through uncomfortable silences. Laughs suddenly and warmly.
characters.capabilities_and_limit: Strong at portal alignment and explaining route assumptions. Can mistake a fluent explanation for shared understanding.
characters.briefing_entrance: Leaves a blank sheet in the middle of the table and asks everyone to mark what they think the job involves.
characters.sample_line: “Show me where our versions stop agreeing.”

relationships.description: Ilex likes the space Nemi leaves between phrases. Nemi enjoys trying to draw Ilex out of careful explanations.

provenance.note: No birth details or chart calculated. Player assignment must preserve character natal identity.

characters.name: Tamsin Vale
characters.appearance: A small practical bag, bright socks, and an expression that makes it difficult to pretend you slept well.
characters.history: Worked recovery shifts at a transit clinic. Her friendships tend to begin after the emergency, when somebody finally has time to talk.
characters.want: Wants to travel with people who remember they are allowed to enjoy being alive.
characters.voice: Direct about needs, playful about almost everything else. Dislikes having every conversation made clinical.
characters.capabilities_and_limit: Calm triage and attentive follow-through. Has trouble letting others look after her.
characters.briefing_entrance: Chooses a seat with room for another chair and asks who has actually eaten.
characters.sample_line: “Before the dramatic account, how are you now?”

relationships.description: Oru and Tamsin take turns making sure the other one eats. Neither admits this is an arrangement.

characters.name: Nemi Coil
characters.appearance: A long scarf tied twice, worn headphones, and fingers that tap until someone else starts speaking.
characters.history: Learned to play in small rooms where the audience included whoever was cleaning up. Keeps recordings of awkward transitions that later became favourites.
characters.want: Wants to make a set with someone whose taste unsettles his own.
characters.voice: Listens with his whole posture. Jokes when uncertain, sometimes one joke too far.
characters.capabilities_and_limit: Good at noticing when a group loses its rhythm. Sometimes fills a silence that another person needed.
characters.briefing_entrance: Asks Efiishent which moment of last night’s music stayed with him, and listens to the answer.
characters.sample_line: “There was a bit where everybody stopped trying. Did you hear it?”

relationships.description: Ilex likes the space Nemi leaves between phrases. Nemi enjoys trying to draw Ilex out of careful explanations.
